value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly asks when higher-order terms preserve the all-orbit local escape of nonsmooth folds. The theorem resolves the complete infinite-dimensional scalar-feedback subclass rather than a small isolated parameter calculation, for all determinant signs, and provides a constructive ball and finite-time estimate with a nondifferentiable Lyapunov gauge. It establishes a precise robustness mechanism of nonlinear tipping independent of linear branch determinant signs.
